user.title: FranklinWH aGate (local)
user.description:
Local polling and control of the aGate. Enter the aGate's LAN IP address.

Data source: Direct Connect (TCP 9000) is used for everything, including control. SunSpec Modbus (TCP 502) is FranklinWH's official read interface — ask FranklinWH support to enable it. With the Modbus backup, it adds lifetime energy and keeps the core readings going if Direct Connect stops working (for example after a firmware update).
